svg.text: Two Shift Regimes for Focus Movement (shift_right / shift_left):

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Mono', 'CMU Typewriter Text', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 1. Classical Schedule (Known Index k): Compiler pointer permutation → 0 Toffolis, 0 SWAPs!

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: 2. Quantum Superposition Index |k⟩: Log-depth Fredkin (CSWAP) Barrel Shifter:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Cost: C * w * log2(C) = 32 * 64 * 5 = 10,240 CSWAPs (Toffolis) in depth O(log C) = 5.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: Width Savings vs. Flat Unrolled Array:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Flat Simultaneous Scratch: C*(w + b) = 32*(64 + 64) = 4,096 Q

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • HuetFocusZipper(32, 64): C*w + b = 32*64 + 64 = 2,112 Q (-48.4% Logical Qubits)

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: 2D Planar Lattice-Surgery Routing Overhead & Yoked Memory Advantage:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Perimeter Routing Bus: 2 * ceil(sqrt(Q_cold)) = 2 * 64 = 128 patches (only 6.3% overhead!).

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Eliminates O(N^2) internal routing checkerboard tracks across 96.9% of the memory array.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Yoked Surface Code [Gidney-Newman-McEwen 2023] on Cold Context Array:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: - Hot Focus + Bus (292 patches @ full 2*d^2, d=27): 425,736 physical qubits

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Mono', 'CMU Typewriter Text', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: - Cold Context (1,072 patches @ yoked 0.5*d^2): 412,568 physical qubits

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Mono', 'CMU Typewriter Text', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace
'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: => TOTAL RSA-2048 Architecture C Physical Qubits: 891,473 Q (Sub-Million Qubit Milestone!)
